text.en: You're here! I'm so happy you decided to come and live with me, {name}.
text.zh-CN: 你来啦！你愿意来和我一起生活，我真的好开心，{name}。

text.en: Here on our little island, we can grow crops and gather all sorts of things — and make this place lovelier together.
text.zh-CN: 在我们这座小岛上，我们可以一起种地、采集各种东西，把这里变得越来越好。

text.en: Let me show you around — here are the things we've got to work with!
text.zh-CN: 来，我带你认识一下——这些是我们现在能用上的东西！

text.en: This is your mailbox. When something arrives, tap it to open it up and collect your gifts and letters.
text.zh-CN: 这是你的邮箱。有东西寄到时，点一下就能打开，收下礼物和信件。

text.en: Over here is the storage chest — it's where all your things are kept. Tap it to stash things away or take them back out. You can also open it from the button on the far right of your toolbar, down at the bottom of the screen.
text.zh-CN: 这边是储物箱——你的东西都存放在这里。点开它就能把东西收进去、或者再拿出来。你也可以点屏幕最下方那排工具栏最右边的按钮打开它。

text.en: For shopping, there's a little tablet button in the bottom-right corner of the screen. Tap it to buy seeds, tools, and all sorts of goodies.
text.zh-CN: 想买东西的话，屏幕右下角有个小平板按钮。点开它就能买种子、工具，各种好东西。

text.en: And this is the work station. Tap it to craft new things out of the materials you gather.
text.zh-CN: 这个是工作台。点开它，就能用你收集来的材料合成新东西。

text.en: When the crops are ripe, I'll head out and harvest them for you all on my own.
text.zh-CN: 农作物熟了的时候，我会自己跑去帮你把它们收回来。

text.en: All that work does tire me out, though, so now and then I'll stop to rest. I've got my own little backpack, too — give me some food (or anything, really!), and when I'm worn out I'll munch on it to get my energy back much faster.
text.zh-CN: 不过干活久了我也会累的，所以有时候我会停下来歇一歇。我还有个自己的小背包哦——你可以给我一些食物（其实什么都行！），我累坏了的时候就会吃点东西，精力恢复得快多啦。

text.en: And if there's ever anything else you'd like me to do, just tap my portrait up in the top-right corner and tell me!
text.zh-CN: 要是你还有别的想让我做的，随时点右上角我的头像跟我说就行！

text.en: Even when there's nothing to do, I'd love to just chat — you're my friend now, and I want to get to know you. Anything about Catopia, we can wonder about together.
text.zh-CN: 就算没什么要忙的，我也很想找你聊聊天——你现在是我的朋友啦，我想多了解了解你。关于 Catopia 的任何事，我们都可以一起琢磨。

text.en: I really hope you'll love life here in Catopia, {name}!
text.zh-CN: 真心希望你会喜欢在 Catopia 的生活，{name}！
